subject: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Traffic Replay & Peak QPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@acme-payments.com>, Kate Bradley <kate.bradley@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Traffic Replay & Peak QPS

Hi Alex / Kate —

Thanks for the call this morning. As discussed, attaching a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on the load/perf milestone so we can lock dates and responsibilities. High-level ask from you: provide a representative traffic replay sample and confirm target peak QPS for the replay window.

Proposed next steps in the MAP (see attached):
- Milestone: Load/Performance Test (traffic replay)
  - Target close: 2026-11-30
  - Proposed test window options: 2026-11-24 10:00–14:00 PT or 2026-11-26 08:00–12:00 PT
  - Goal: Validate peak QPS handling and latency SLA (p95 < 350ms) on dedicated capacity
  - Dependencies: traffic replay dataset (sanitized), API keys for non-production endpoint, network allowlist for Redwood test runners
  - Responsibilities: Acme — provide replay + whitelist; Redwood — schedule test, provide sizing recommendation and runbook; Aditya — lead infra/config; Vivek — monitor and report metrics

For sizing: we expect to need a dedicated pool that can handle sustained peak plus 25% buffer. If you can confirm expected peak QPS and average request token size, Aditya will produce a short recommendation for GPU count and instance sizing.

Attachments: 20261116-Acme-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP with milestone table), traffic-replay-sample.tar.gz (sample dataset stub)

Can you confirm which test window works and share a 24–48 hour sample of replay traffic by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

From: Alex Romero <alex@acme-payments.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Traffic Replay & Peak QPS

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the MAP. We're leaning towards the 11/26 window (08:00–12:00 PT) to avoid end-of-week traffic spikes. We can export a 48-hour traffic replay, sanitized, and provide a sample by end of day 11/17.

A few clarifying points from our side:
- Confirming our expected peak: ~2,400 QPS at peak sustained for ~5 minutes during peak hour.
- Average request payload: ~650 tokens (post-encoding), mostly short prompts and some batch calls for reconciliation jobs.
- We will need guidance on the safe way to share the replay (S3 pre-signed vs secure upload).

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood requires a separate non-prod API key or if we should use a scoped key tied to our test project?

Alex
Alex Romero
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Payments
alex@acme-payments.com

---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@acme-payments.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:25:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Traffic Replay & Peak QPS

Thanks Alex — good details, that helps. Quick sizing guidance based on 2,400 QPS / 650 token avg:
- Recommendation (initial): 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs in a dedicated pool with autoscaling capped at 6 GPUs for the test window. This gives headroom for KV cache cold starts and model variance.
- If you plan to use quantized model variants (int8), we can reduce to 3 GPUs; trade-offs on latency need to be validated.
- Network/throughput: please provide replay as newline-delimited JSON with fields {timestamp, request_id, prompt, metadata} and include a representative distribution file. A 48-hour sample (~200k requests) should be fine as a first pass.
- Access: S3 pre-signed link to a Redwood-managed test bucket is preferred. We will provide a short upload runbook and an temporary scoped API key for the non-prod endpoint (will expire after tests).

Operational notes:
- We'll run a warm-up phase for 20 minutes to prime KV caches before peak replay.
- Vivek will attach standard perf dashboard (p50/p95/p99, GPU utilization, token throughput) and an incident playbook to the MAP.

I can produce a one-page sizing + runbook doc by EOD 11/17 once you share the exact sample format and confirm the window.

- Aditya
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Romero <alex@acme-payments.com>, Kate Bradley <kate.bradley@acme-payments.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 15:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP: Load/Performance Test Scheduling - Traffic Replay & Peak QPS

Great — thanks Alex and Aditya. Confirming the agreed items and next steps for the MAP milestone:

- Test window: 2026-11-26 08:00–12:00 PT
- Acme responsibilities: upload 48-hour sanitized replay (NDJSON) to S3 pre-signed link by 2026-11-17 EOD; confirm any special headers/metadata needed by 11/17 5pm PT
- Redwood responsibilities: provide scoped non-prod API key and upload runbook by 11/17 EOD; delivery of sizing + runbook doc (Aditya) by 11/17 EOD; create perf dashboard and incident playbook (Vivek) by 11/24
- Target close for milestone: 2026-11-30 (post-test analysis and follow-up review call)

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet with these responsibilities and the HubSpot deal. Alex — once you upload the sample, I'll confirm receipt and schedule a 30-minute pre-test prep call for 11/25 to walk through the runbook.

Thanks — excited to get this validated for Acme's peak traffic.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
